kim2026immopd.question: How can one student recover the capabilities of multiple teachers?
kim2026immopd.summary: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation trains a student on its own generated samples using feedback from specialized teachers. IM-MOPD starts with a uniform model merge, then progressively adds teacher task-vector updates for domains the student has not recovered well. Across five domains, it improves average capability recovery over the tested uniform-merge and supervised warm-up baselines.
kim2026immopd.takeaway: Recovering specialized teacher capabilities through iterative merging during distillation.
kim2026immopd.image_alt: Comparison of MOPD and IM-MOPD, showing iterative teacher task-vector additions during student distillation

kim2026persona.question: Can a smaller model preserve a specific persona?
kim2026persona.summary: Persona-Pruner uses a persona description to identify a specialized subnetwork within a language model. In the reported experiments, it preserves role-playing quality better than the pruning baselines while retaining general capabilities.
kim2026persona.takeaway: Pruning language models while preserving their role-playing capabilities.

hong2025cross.question: Can reward models transfer across languages?
hong2025cross.summary: The study finds that English-trained reward models can transfer effectively to other languages. It examines changes in model representations and shows how this transfer can support multilingual instruction following.
hong2025cross.takeaway: Transferring English reward models to support multilingual alignment.

hong2024orpo.question: Can fine-tuning and preference alignment share one training stage?
hong2024orpo.summary: ORPO adds an odds-ratio preference objective to supervised fine-tuning. It favors preferred responses without a separate reference model or an additional alignment stage, with experiments across models from 125 million to 7 billion parameters.
hong2024orpo.takeaway: Combining supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment without a reference model.
